topic: 地点、方向与正在发生的事
grammarFocus: there is / are；地点介词；现在进行时；祈使句入门。
title: At the Train Station
instructions: 这是为A1水平学习者设计的听力练习。请听一段关于在火车站的对话，然后回答问题。注意：对话是模拟的，不是真实的火车站广播。
transcript: A: Excuse me, where is the ticket office? B: It is over there, next to the coffee shop. A: Thank you. And where are the toilets? B: The toilets are behind you, near the stairs. A: Oh, I see. Is there a shop here? B: Yes, there is a small shop. It is between the ticket office and the platform. A: Great. What is the woman doing? B: She is buying a ticket. A: And what are the children doing? B: They are waiting for the train. A: Are they eating? B: No, they are not eating. They are drinking water. A: Thank you. B: You're welcome. Please stand behind the yellow line.

options: Between the shop and the platform

grammar.title: There is / There are; 地点介词; 现在进行时; 祈使句入门
grammar.explanation: 我们用“There is”表示单数名词的存在，用“There are”表示复数名词的存在。地点介词如“next to”（在……旁边）、“behind”（在……后面）、“between...and...”（在……和……之间）用来描述位置。现在进行时表示正在发生的动作，结构是“am/is/are + 动词-ing”。祈使句用来发出指令，比如“Please stand behind the yellow line.”。
grammar.example: There is a small shop. The toilets are behind you. She is buying a ticket. Please stand behind the yellow line.

questions.prompt: There ___ a book on the table.

questions.explanation: 主语“She”是第三人称单数，现在进行时用“is + 动词-ing”。
祈使句常以“Please”开头表示礼貌请求。
questions.evidence: Please stand behind the yellow line.
